meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作按时间轴编排的可渲染视觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过代码和 HTML 亲手制作动态影像作品
copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft dynamic animations with code and HTML.

howto.what: Claude会按HyperFrames规范编写组合HTML:用data-*属性设定时间,管理class="clip"、轨道、子组合和变量,媒体播放交给框架,并遵循确定性渲染规则;写前还会先读STORYBOARD/SCRIPT计划。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或修改HyperFrames组合HTML,涉及组合结构、data-*时间属性、class="clip"等,或要求校验、生成STORYBOARD/SCRIPT计划时。

howto.what_en: Guides Claude to build HyperFrames compositions as HTML files with data-* timing attributes, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, and framework-owned media, following deterministic-render rules and validation. Also reads STORYBOARD/SCRIPT plans before writing.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to build or edit HyperFrames composition HTML, involving data-* attributes, class="clip", sub-compositions, etc., or requests validation or STORYBOARD/SCRIPT plans.

say_en.note: It returns the smallest renderable skeleton.
